title: Left-to-right reading: The critical limitation of older NLP models
text: Time in order. By the time the model reaches headwinds at the end, it has already decided how to feel about revenue at the beginning. It cannot go back. So a sentence that starts positive and ends cautious gets classified as positive because the model made up its mind too early. A transformer does not read left to right. It reads everything at once. Every word looks at every other word and asks one question. How much do you matter to me? Revenue looks at headwinds and increases its attention.
